patterns.note: The primary content area is consistently centered and uses generous horizontal padding, creating an airy and focused presentation for the main message.
A striking, oversized numeric display (e.g., '404') uses a vibrant gradient fill, serving as a dominant visual element and brand accent.
A consistent purple-to-pink gradient is used as a primary accent for large text, interactive elements like buttons, and subtle background flourishes.
The header navigation remains sticky at the top of the viewport, maintaining its full height and background as the user scrolls down the page.
Content is organized into distinct sections, such as 'Popular Categories' presented as a horizontal scrollable list of tags, followed by a multi-column footer.

technique_notes: The main header navigation is implemented as a sticky element, fixed to the top of the viewport, ensuring constant access to site navigation without any visual transformation on scroll.
The prominent '404' text utilizes a large, bold typeface with a linear gradient applied as a text fill, creating a vibrant and eye-catching focal point.
Interactive elements like search inputs and call-to-action buttons feature subtle, consistent rounded corners and often incorporate the brand's accent gradient for visual emphasis.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold display text (~5-6x body) with clear, legible body text and smaller, functional navigation/label text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on interactive elements like buttons, search fields, and category tags.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and balanced, particularly in the hero section, with generous vertical spacing between major content blocks and a more compact but still well-defined footer.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the use of an extremely large, gradient-filled '404' text, which transforms a utilitarian error page into a visually engaging and memorable brand moment. This bold typographic statement, combined with soft background gradients, elevates the page's aesthetic significantly.
